citations.quote: Our daughter, who is five, has had one sinus infection after another this autumn; the paediatrician asked us straight away whether there is mould in the flat, and told us that it is very likely the reason.
The second issue is the bathroom: the ceiling has grey-green mould on it, and there is a musty smell in the hallway.
Two of our four radiators stay cold even when turned up fully.
I have not decided whether I want to go that far; we have a good relationship with the foundation otherwise.
The defective part will be replaced as soon as the supplier delivers it. The contractor will need access to your flat on 10 November 2026 from 8 a.m.; please let us know if this date is not possible.
We have informed our heating contractor, Gebr. Bühler AG, who has identified the defective valve unit.

plan.because: Needed to establish the parties, property and tenancy terms.
Obtain the original reports showing which defects were reported and when.
Evidence of the landlord's receipt and its date is missing.
Obtain dated images showing the affected locations and visible defects.
The supplied letter addresses heating work and access, but does not establish the complete response history, including the mould.
Mould is reported; dated moisture and temperature observations are relevant.
Heating defects are reported. The landlord's letter is not the contractor's inspection report and does not give the inspection date or full findings.
Health effects are reported; obtain medical findings and any limits on attribution. Prioritise immediate health or safety concerns.
A specialist need is not mentioned and is presumed absent for planning; the cause remains open.
The customer has raised but not decided on the deposit route. Clarify whether it is being considered before requesting its conditional evidence.
This is optional under the process.

questions: Is there an immediate health or safety concern requiring urgent advice, especially for your daughter?
Do you want advice on considering an official rent deposit? Have you given the landlord a written repair deadline?
When and how did you report each defect, particularly the bathroom mould, and what response or access arrangements followed?
Has a technical inspection been recommended or conducted to investigate the mould or its cause?
